entries.title: Field changes show up in History
entries.summary: renaming a field, changing its type, or adding, renaming or removing a dropdown option is now recorded in **History → Audit** under the **Field** type, with who did it and when. Deleting a field is recorded too, and the entry keeps the deleted field's name so the history still reads properly afterwards. Changes made through the public API appear alongside the rest.

entries.title: Membership, permission and API token changes are recorded
entries.summary: inviting someone to the organization, changing their permission role, removing their access, editing a permission profile, and creating or revoking an API token all now leave an entry in History. Token values are never recorded.

entries.title: History filters are grouped
entries.summary: the **Type** and **Action** filters separate records from configuration and from access and security, so the list stays scannable as more of the product is covered. Both narrow the CSV export as well as the screen.
